# Price the classroom, not just the seat.

> Free daycare and childcare tuition calculator. Price a classroom from your own child:staff ratio, staffing cost, and overhead, and see what an empty seat actually costs you at every occupancy level.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/childcare-tuition-calculator/)
- [How to price daycare tuition without underpricing an empty seat](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/childcare-tuition-calculator/how-to-price-daycare-tuition.html)
- [This calculator vs. pricing tuition by hand or in a spreadsheet](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/childcare-tuition-calculator/vs-doing-it-by-hand.html)
- [This calculator vs. Procare](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/childcare-tuition-calculator/vs-procare.html)
